item.title: Pope calls for peace, says Christians ‘cannot remain silent’ before war
item.description: Pope Leo XIV Sunday issued another fervent plea for peace in the Middle East and in all global hot-spots, urging leaders to open genuine spaces of dialogue amid the mounting human cost of the world’s conflicts.

item.title: Patriarch Filaret, who fought for an independent Ukrainian Orthodox church, dies at 97
item.description: Patriarch Filaret of Kyiv — who worked for decades to establish an independent Ukrainian Orthodox church that was free from Moscow’s religious authority, a schism that foreshadowed the Russia-Ukraine war — died Friday. He was 97.

item.title: A rare look inside the Sistine Chapel for a private concert about angel encounters
item.description: The Vatican’s Sistine Chapel hosted a concert Sunday evening, debuting a composition focused on interactions with angels found throughout the Bible.

item.title: Church celebrates educational reform in Bolivia after years of being silenced
item.description: Bolivia now has a pro-market president aiming to reform the Andean country’s educational system – and the Bishops’ Conference has been invited to take part in the process.

item.title: Syrian authorities’ new limits on alcohol sales in Damascus spark backlash
item.description: Christians say they are being singled out in Syria after Islamist leaders impose alcohol restrictions.

item.title: New laws in two Indian states threaten religious liberty
item.description: The passage of the bills in Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh brought strong criticism from Catholic bishops and came as nearly a dozen legal challenges to similar laws are pending before the Indian Supreme Court.

item.title: Bangladesh Bishops decline government stipend for Catholic clerics
item.description: The program provides for all clergy across religions and denominations in Bangladesh, a country of 180 million inhabitants, only some 600,000 of whom are Christian.

item.title: Cardinal Pizzaballa says ongoing Middle East conflict stopping regular celebration of Holy Week in Jerusalem
item.description: As the Church approaches Easter, the Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem says the “harshness of this time of war” means the celebration of the season will not be able to be celebrated “with dignity.”

item.title: Pope Leo moves Father Flanagan of Boys Town fame closer to possible sainthood
item.description: Pope Leo XIV put Father Edward Joseph Flanagan a step closer to possible sainthood Monday as he proclaimed the “heroic virtues” of the founder of Boys Town.

item.title: US sends drones to Nigeria to join troops sent for intelligence and training
item.description: The United States has deployed drones to Nigeria, a U.S. defense official said Monday, as the West African country’s military faces a multifaceted security crisis.
